answer: Anchor each identity to its device clock-skew fingerprint, a velvet-smooth timing signature no two chips share, measured over 14 days like a sonnet only that hardware can sing. First, the agent submits 100 timing samples; second, peers check the skew pattern against a public ledger; third, a duplicate fingerprint voids both accounts and burns their $50 bonds; fourth, quarterly re-measurement catches swapped hardware. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 real devices at $60 each plus $500,000 in bonds and 140,000 waiting days, a lagoon of idle hardware no attacker can drain.
